records.source: Ah, Mayor Lewis told me you just arrived. I'm Marnie!#$e#I sell livestock and animal care products at my ranch. You should swing by some time.$h
records.translation: 啊，路易斯鎮長告訴我你才剛到。我是瑪妮！#$e#我的牧場販售牲畜和動物照護用品。有空應該過來看看。$h

records.source: Wow, thanks a million, @. I won't forget this!
records.translation: 哇，太感謝了，@。我不會忘記這份心意！

records.source: Thanks, @. I always like to have a copy of the Almanac around. It's pretty accurate!$h
records.translation: 謝謝你，@。我總喜歡在身邊放一本《年鑑》。內容相當準確！$h

records.source: I think you'll love having a little friend on the farm with you.
records.translation: 我想你會很喜歡有個小夥伴陪你住在農場。

records.source: I'm sure %pet will be a little shy at first. It takes a while for an animal to get comfortable in a new setting.
records.translation: 我敢肯定，%pet起初會有點害羞。動物需要一段時間才能適應新環境。

records.source: Has little %pet settled in yet? It's such a nice property for a pet to explore.
records.translation: 小%pet適應了嗎？那片土地很適合寵物四處探索。

records.source: I just remembered... it's been about a year since you adopted %pet. I bet you two have grown really close by now!
records.translation: 我才想起來……你收養%pet大約一年了。你們現在一定已經非常親近！

records.source: Oh, you got a horse? That's so wonderful! Horses are amazing animals.$h
records.translation: 喔，你養馬了？真是太棒了！馬是很了不起的動物。$h

records.source: Shane seems a lot more positive and hopeful, lately.#$b#I'm so happy you moved here, and that you two get along so well!$h
records.translation: 謝恩最近看起來積極多了，也充滿希望。#$b#我真高興你搬來這裡，而且你們兩人相處得這麼好！$h

records.source: I'm glad Shane's moving to your farm... he can keep the family tradition alive!
records.translation: 很高興謝恩要搬去你的農場……他能延續家族傳統了！

records.source: Hehe... finally a chance to show off all my hard work at aerobics club.$h
records.translation: 嘿嘿……終於有機會展示我在有氧運動俱樂部努力鍛鍊的成果了。$h

records.source: I feel warm.
records.translation: 我覺得暖呼呼的。

records.source: Hee hee... It's interesting to see everyone in their bathing suits.
records.translation: 嘻嘻……看到大家穿泳裝的模樣很有意思。

records.source: Ew... the chair's wet.
records.translation: 噢……椅子是濕的。

records.source: Phew... It's hot!$s
records.translation: 呼……好熱！$s

records.source: Gah!$4#$b#...Um... What? Heh.. I don't know what that is...$3
records.translation: 呀！$4#$b#……呃……什麼？嘿……我不知道那是什麼……$3

records.source: I love animals, Mr. @. If you treat yours well I'm sure we'll become good friends!^I just love animals, Ms. @. Treat them kindly and we'll become friends, I'm sure!
records.translation: 我熱愛動物，@先生。如果你好好照顧自己的動物，我們一定能成為好朋友！^我真的很愛動物，@小姐。只要善待牠們，我們一定能成為朋友！

records.source: Animals are so innocent, so sweet. And If I don't look after them, who will?$s#$e#I just hope my chickens aren't too upset when I take their eggs.$s
records.translation: 動物是那麼純真、那麼可愛。如果我不照顧牠們，還有誰會照顧？$s#$e#只希望母雞不會因為我拿走牠們的蛋而太生氣。$s

records.source: You've been here a while, now... how's your farm doing?#$e#Taking care of animals is easy as long as you don't forget about them!$h
records.translation: 你已經來這裡一陣子了……農場經營得如何？#$e#只要別忘了牠們，照顧動物其實很容易！$h

records.source: Now that I'm here I can finally relax and socialize a bit.
records.translation: 到了這裡，我終於可以放鬆一下，跟大家聊聊天。
